# Get Podcast Episodes

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retreives the episodes from a podcast.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getPodcastEpisodes(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getPodcastEpisodes(input: Podcast)
~~~~
